title: The Steward's Mortgaged Whistle
logline: An unaligned orbital racing referee refuses to penalize a reckless privateer team after a fatal crash, hiding that his own luxury yacht is mortgaged to the offending team's sponsor.

roles.description: Chief orbital racing steward; fastidious, compromised, and hiding a colossal private yacht mortgage behind his referee badge.
Chief engineer of the victim's racing crew; grieving, furious, and demanding an immediate disqualification.
Wealthy financier behind the reckless winning skiff; arrogant, litigious, and holding the referee's promissory notes.
The observation pylon overlooking the orbital racecourse where telemetry is officially certified.
The pressurized pit bays where high-performance racing craft are overhauled between heats.

public_situation: Fury erupts across the racing paddocks at {role:racing_paddock_dock} after the chief steward rules a fatal high-speed ramming as an unavoidable racing collision.
private_truth: {role:racing_referee} cannot disqualify the winning team because their owner holds the debt deed to his luxury yacht and threatened immediate foreclosure.

beats.public_change: Pit crews stage an angry sit-in outside {role:steward_flag_spire}, demanding access to the flight telemetry recorders.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to collect the sealed telemetry beacon from the crashed racer's wreckage before rioting mechanics seize it.
missions.private_fact: The telemetry clearly proves the winning skiff overloaded its thrusters to deliberately side-swipe its rival into a pylon.

beats.public_change: {role:team_sponsor} threatens legal action against anyone questioning the race result, waving the referee's official clearance.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the flag spire's communication relays to verify whether the referee accepted financial transfers from the winning sponsor.
missions.private_fact: She found bank receipts showing the sponsor extended the referee's yacht mortgage forbearance two hours before the race began.

beats.public_change: Mechanics arm themselves with heavy cutting torches to storm the trophy podium as the awards ceremony opens.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to rush the finalized race certification docket to the broadcast suite before the paddock breaches his office.
missions.private_fact: His vow of impartial neutrality is a desperate sham to keep his boat from being repossessed by the sponsor's banking cartel.

player_choice.prompt: With the telemetry proof of murder and the mortgage collusion in hand, the pilot must decide whether to uphold the corrupt ruling, expose the referee, or force a disqualification.

options.label: Broadcast the crash telemetry to force an immediate disqualification and vindicate the pit crew
Deliver the certification so the referee keeps his yacht and the sponsor claims the cup
Sell the mortgage records to the racing league board to strip both the team and the referee

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the crash telemetry across the paddocks.
resolutions.summary: Outraged fans force the league to strip {role:team_sponsor}'s team. {role:aggrieved_pit_boss} wins justice, but the sponsor forecloses on {role:racing_referee}'s yacht.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broadcast telemetry proving a deadly orbital racing collision was deliberate ramming covered up by a compromised steward.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the certification to uphold the ruling.
resolutions.summary: {role:team_sponsor} hovers the championship trophy. {role:racing_referee} keeps his luxury yacht, while {role:aggrieved_pit_boss}'s crew is banned from the league for protesting.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot delivered the certification papers that let a murderous racing sponsor take the championship cup.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands the mortgage proof to the league board.
resolutions.summary: The league board expels both {role:team_sponsor} and {role:racing_referee}. The race is annulled, leaving {role:aggrieved_pit_boss} vindicated but bitter.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed how an orbital racing referee sold race decisions to pay off his luxury pleasure boat.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the delivery.
resolutions.summary: Furious mechanics breach the observation spire with industrial torches. {role:racing_referee} flees in his yacht while the paddocks are shut down by riot patrols.

loose_threads.detail: The vessel registry lists the referee's pleasure yacht as pledged collateral to a commercial finance consortium.
The flight recorder contains encrypted firmware patches authored by an uncertified offshore engine tuner.

radio_hooks: Orbital racing championship marred by fatal crash during qualifying sprint.
Chief steward defends non-penalty ruling, calling incident 'within racing tolerance'.
Betting syndicates freeze payouts as mechanic protests paralyze paddock docks.

voice_direction.racing_referee: Pompous, defensive, and hides behind sports rulebook jargon. Becomes nervous and evasive when personal finances are mentioned.
voice_direction.aggrieved_pit_boss: Gravelly, choked with fury, and blunt as a torque wrench. Refuses polite pleasantries and demands immediate action.
voice_direction.team_sponsor: Arrogant, patronizing, and treats sporting regulations as minor contractual technicalities easily settled with cash.
